subject: Film & Cinema
title: Coverage and the Gatekeepers
description: A micro-lesson that makes Coverage and the Gatekeepers usable.

hook.text: Before any executive reads your script, an underpaid assistant writes a one-page verdict.

buildup.text: Coverage is a brief summary and recommendation — pass, consider, or recommend.

discovery.text: Most scripts receive a 'pass' within the first ten pages if the opening doesn't hook.

twist.text: Legendary scripts like Die Hard were initially passed on by multiple studios.

climax.text: The system is imperfect, but it's how thousands of scripts get filtered every year.

punchline.text: Your script's fate rests on page one.

quiz.question: What is 'coverage' in the Hollywood script process?
options: A brief summary and recommendation by a reader
